sources.notes: SATHEE reproduces the SSC CPO indicative Quantitative Aptitude scope and explicitly separates Geometry theorem topics from mensuration solids/measurement topics.
The CHSL indicative syllabus repeats the same elementary Geometry theorem scope.
Used only as pattern evidence; question wording is not copied into Examtree authority.
Provides additional representation evidence for centres, tangent equality and circle/triangle synthesis.
Direct SSC CGL Tier-I PYQ pattern evidence for the angle between two tangents.
Direct SSC CGL Tier-II pattern evidence for semicircle plus cyclic-angle synthesis.
Broad taxonomy reference only; taxonomy presence alone does not establish PYQ saturation.
Useful for Punjab school-level terminology and theorem baseline, but not accepted as Punjab recruitment-exam PYQ saturation evidence.

SSC.notes: CGL/CHSL/CPO scope directly supports triangle centres, congruence/similarity and circle theorem families. PYQ evidence reveals additional circle, centre, similarity and mixed-synthesis representations beyond current Wave-1 prototypes.

BANKING.notes: No contemporary banking-specific Geometry evidence was established in this audit. Do not activate Geometry for banking mocks from generic quantitative-aptitude assumptions.

PUNJAB_STATE.notes: Punjab school curriculum supports theorem terminology, but dedicated Punjab recruitment-exam PYQ evidence is still required before state-exam saturation or eligibility is claimed.

rules: Diagram disposition is assigned to normalized learner archetypes, not randomly per seed.
A required stem diagram must encode topology or semantic givens that prose alone would not convey naturally and unambiguously.
No theorem-derived equality, perpendicularity, parallelism, angle or target value may be visually leaked in a stem.
NO_DIAGRAM remains preferred for pure polygon arithmetic and other tasks where a figure adds no learner inference.
All surviving diagrammed families require semantic-parity, anti-leak, mobile, accessibility and localisation review before permanent QL freeze.

crossChapterFindings.finding: Coordinate Geometry is outside this chapter family.
crossChapterFindings.action: Do not absorb coordinate-distance, slope or analytic-circle tasks into GEO-001/GEO-002.

crossChapterFindings.finding: Mensuration owns requested area, perimeter, surface-area and volume computation unless a geometry theorem itself is the learner decision.
crossChapterFindings.action: Similarity area-ratio evidence requires an explicit ownership review before runtime promotion.

crossChapterFindings.finding: Trigonometry owns trigonometric-ratio solves and heights/distances.
crossChapterFindings.action: Do not promote trig-assisted triangle computation into Geometry merely because the stimulus is geometric.
